note: House rules: cards always treated as an archetype's card, like Summoned Skull and "Archfiend" (user, 2026-11-19: Dark Sage is a "Dark Magician" card). campaign_expansion.install adds the setcodes and the English line after the card's text, tools/build_android.py adds the setcodes to engine-data.json, and tools/i18n/build_bundles.py adds the translated line. The card's script is unchanged.
